```python
# filename: compute_percentage_increase.py
import pandas as pd

data = [
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Index Fund", "Ticker": "FPADX", "NAV May 2019": 11.20, "NAV May 2024": 12.35, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund", "Ticker": "FEMKX", "NAV May 2019": 28.50, "NAV May 2024": 29.70, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Asia Fund", "Ticker": "FSEAX", "NAV May 2019": 27.00, "NAV May 2024": 33.10, "Transaction Fee": "$0"},
    {"Fund Name": "Fidelity Emerging Markets Small Cap Fund", "Ticker": "FEMSX", "NAV May 2019": 35.10, "NAV May 2024": 36.80, "Transaction Fee": "$0"}
]

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df["Percentage Increase (%)"] = ((df["NAV May 2024"] - df["NAV May 2019"]) / df["NAV May 2019"]) * 100

print("\nSorted ascending by Percentage Increase:")
print(df.sort_values("Percentage Increase (%)")[["Fund Name","Ticker","Percentage Increase (%)"]].to_string(index=False))
```
